items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 144:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the dainties of kings? The Mochin that are revealed in the illumination of Hochma are called the dainties of kings, because the place of the revelation of the illumination of Hochma is in Malchut, which is the Nukva of ZA, as is known. (Item 62).
